svg.desc: Exact inclusion diagrams for the 60-element and 59-element lcm-lattices of the six-generator ideals I and J. Filled pale nodes mark their common 56-element Betti poset, counting the bottom. Hollow nodes are not in the Betti poset. Deleting the amber element with atom set 23456 preserves the Betti poset but changes ideal Stanley projective dimension from 3 to 2. The ideals have 5 and 7 ambient variables; their Stanley depths are 2 and 5. The layout is schematic, but every node and cover relation is computed from the stated lattices. This is not a counterexample to Stanley’s inequality or to the quotient assertion.
